etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From Latin stigma, from Ancient Greek στίγμα (stígma, “mark of slavery or disgrace”), from στίζω (stízō, “to mark”). Closely related to stigme, and distantly related to stick.
senses: An indication of infamy or disgrace.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From Medieval Greek στίγμα (stígma), likely coined by analogy with σίγμα (sígma).
senses: (typography) A ligature of the Greek letters sigma and tau: Ϛ / ϛ.
